purpose: Implementation baseline; no architecture or hyperparameter search

audio.selection: Lowest development NLL within fixed training budget
audio.calibration: One scalar temperature fitted to calibration split only
audio.test: Evaluate frozen selected checkpoint once; do not tune from outcomes
audio.output_head: Mutually exclusive class softmax; no overlapping-event claim

screen.selection: Two text and two icon examples from each of six fixed apps, hashed IDs
crop_type_prompts: a text label in a computer interface
a graphical icon in a computer interface
screen.scope: Diagnostic external probe, not an official full benchmark or final model acceptance set

failure_policy: Fix implementation errors with regression checks. Preserve any completed result; use a new run ID for reruns. Do not tune to held-out scores.
